extracted.intended_audience: students completing an in-class creative writing assignment (classroom writer/submitter)
extracted.subtask_description: A classroom rubric for a timed, in-class short story / creative writing piece (one page max) that students write during an hour; assesses introduction, creativity, originality, mechanics, conflict, organization/pacing, climax, and resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction (Grabber / Setup)
rubrics_metrics.description: The first paragraph has a “grabber” and effectively sets up the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scoring levels provided: Effective — 5 pts: first paragraph has a “grabber” and effectively sets up the story. Adequate — 4 pts: a catchy beginning was attempted but was not continued throughout the piece. Approaching — 2 pts: the first paragraph has a weak “grabber” and/or weakly sets up the story. Below Standard — 0 pts: no attempt was made to catch the reader’s attention or introduce the story in the first paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity (use of descriptive detail)
rubrics_metrics.description: The story's creative details and descriptions contribute to the reader's enjoyment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High level: 'The story contains an abundance of creative details and/or descriptions that contribute to the reader’s enjoyment.' Mid levels: 'The story contains a few creative details and/or descriptions that adequately contribute to the reader’s enjoyment.' Lower/misused: 'The story contains a few creative details and/or descriptions, but they distract from the story.' Below standard: 'The story heavily lacks creative detail and/or description.' Use these descriptions to judge whether details enhance, merely suffice, distract, or are absent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality of plot and clarity/strength of the writer’s voice throughout the piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High level: 'There is an original plot to the story and the writer’s voice is clear, noticeable and impressive throughout the piece.' Mid level: 'There is an original plot to the story and the writer’s voice is fairly clear throughout the piece.' Low level: 'The story lacks an original plot and the writer’s voice is hard to distinguish throughout the piece.' Below standard: 'The story lacks an original plot and the writer’s voice is missing or very unclear throughout the piece.' Use voice distinctiveness and plot originality as core evaluative factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mechanics / Formatting / Instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Adherence to formatting (Arial 12 pt, ≤ one page, default margins) and correctness of grammar/spelling; following instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expected best: 'It is in Arial 12pt font. Everything is grammatically correct and spelled correctly. It is less than or equal to one page with default margins and all steps of the instructions are correctly followed.' Mid: 'It is not in Arial 12pt font and/or there are mild spelling or grammatical errors that do not necessarily hinder the readability of the piece. Most of the instructions are followed.' Worse: 'It is not in Arial 12pt font and/or there are spelling or grammatical errors [that] hinder the flow or readability of the piece. The instructions are not followed closely.' Below standard: 'It is not in Arial or 12pt font and/or there are spelling or grammatical errors [that] significantly hinder the flow or readability of the piece. The instructions were completely ignored.' Additional scoring note: 'If you print to the wrong printer it is an automatic 10 points off.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Problem / Conflict
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarity of the problem the main characters face and how engaging/complex the conflict is.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top level: 'It is very easy to understand the problem the main characters face and why it is a problem. The conflict is complex and engaging.' Mid: 'It is fairly easy to understand the problem the main characters face and why it’s a problem and/or the conflict is adequate and sufficiently engaging.' Lower: 'It is fairly easy to understand the problem that the main characters face but it is not clear why it’s a problem and/or the conflict is simple and mildly engaging.' Below standard: 'The conflict is missing or unclear.' Use clarity of stakes and complexity/engagement of the conflict to assign level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization / Pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall organization of the story and whether pacing effectively communicates tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best: 'The story is organized exceptionally well and the pacing effectively communicates the tone.' Adequate: 'The story is adequately organized (few elements are out of place) and/or the pacing adequately communicates the tone.' Weak: 'The story is weakly organized (a couple elements are out of place) and/or the pacing weakly communicates the tone.' Below standard: 'The story is not organized (many elements are out of place) and/or the pacing weakly communicates the tone.' Consider structure, scene order, transitions and tempo relative to intended tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climax (Turning Point)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition and effectiveness of the story's turning point/climax and how it addresses the conflict.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best: 'It is very easy to understand the turning point/climax and it effectively addresses the conflict.' Adequate: 'It is fairly easy understand the turning point/climax and/or it adequately addresses the conflict.' Weak: 'The turning point/climax is recognizable but the purpose of turning point/climax is unclear.' Below standard: 'The turning point/climax is missing or unclear.' Judge whether the climax is clear, purposeful, and resolves or reframes the central conflict.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closing / Resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: How the story winds down to an ending and how effectively the resolution addresses the conflict and climax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best: 'The story effectively winds down to a logical ending and effectively addresses the conflict and climax.' Adequate: 'The story adequately winds down to a logical ending and/or adequately addresses the conflict and climax.' Weak: 'The story abruptly ends and/or the resolution weakly addresses the conflict and climax.' Below standard: 'The resolution is illogical, missing, or unclear.' Evaluate logical closure and whether the resolution follows from the climax and conflict.
